The Liberator
Likes civilizations that have kept the peace for a long time. Dislikes those that recently declared war.
Alexander II appreciates that you have kept the peace for a long time
Alexander II is displeased that you recently declared war
(You have kept the peace)
(You recently declared war)
Adds Alexander II as an alternative leader of Russia.
Alexander II for Russia.
Thank you. Russia values such friendship.
I accept your offer of friendship. May it serve both our peoples.
Your delegation is welcome. We shall receive it with due honor.
Reasonable. Let us consider the matter settled.
Our borders are open to you. Let trade and travel flourish.
Russia would be glad to count you as a friend. Shall we declare it?
I have tried to keep the peace, but you leave me no choice. Russia will defend her interests.
I sought peace for a long time. Now there is none, and the fault is yours.
The empire has fallen, but the work of reform will outlive me.
The empire has fallen, but the work of reform will outlive me.
I have sent a delegation to you with gifts from Russia.
Your conduct is unworthy of a great power. Russia will not forget it. (Denounces You).
You are entitled to think so. Time will judge.
The Emperor of All Russia greets you. I hope our nations will find common ground.
Thank you. A good beginning.
Tell me about your land. Russia is vast, and we have much to learn from one another.
Come to our nearest city and see how Russia is changing.
I am glad to see you. Russia desires peace and good works.
Your state is well governed. Such order serves its people.
Would you like to form an alliance?
Peace is the better road. I accept.
Not yet. This war is not over.
Enough blood has been shed. Let us make peace.
Will you allow our people and goods to cross your lands?
A pity.
I cannot accept this now. Perhaps later.
Not at this time.
No. The time for this has not yet come.
We are not ready to open our borders.
You declared war, and I cannot overlook it. Russia remembers.
Withdraw your troops from our borders. Do not provoke me.
